page.description: PureOS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A fully auditable, privacy-respecting Linux distribution developed by Purism. Built on Debian, it ships with only free software and supports hardware convergence between desktop and mobile.
pros: Fully free software, no proprietary blobs
Hardware convergence support for Librem devices
cons: Tied to the Purism ecosystem for full hardware support
Limited hardware compatibility outside Librem devices
Smaller software selection than mainstream distros
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for PureOS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO to a USB stick with BalenaEtcher; select the image, choose the USB drive, and click Flash. Boot from the USB and follow the installation wizard.
